review:
The officially licensed Star Trek game, with cascading reels and the Enterprise crew, including Deanna Troi and Data. Filling the power meter starts the Next Generation Respin Bonus.

A three-level Warp Speed Wheel hands out instant prizes, and you choose from four free spins 'missions'. You can buy the respin bonus or free spins. Medium-high volatility, 10,000x max and 96.46% RTP. Free spins about once every 197 spins. Fans will love the detail.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
